description: This Java class 'LocalHostAddressSupplier' provides a singleton implementation for retrieving the local host address based on the environment or hostname. It caches the address after first lookup and throws a custom error if resolution fails.

classes.name: LocalHostAddressSupplier
classes.description: A singleton supplier class that provides the host address of the local machine. It retrieves and caches the address, throwing a custom error if hostname resolution fails.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the LocalHostAddressSupplier.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the cached local host address, resolving it if not already cached.

methods.name: tryToGetHostAddress
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the hostname to an IP address, throws detailed error if unable.

methods.name: getHostAddress
methods.description: Resolves the hostname to an IP address using InetAddress.
